annotation.title_clean: Education - Artificial Intelligence - Guidelines, Professional Development, and Collaborative (Artificial Intelligence Ready Schools Act) - SB 720 Fiscal and Policy Note
annotation.title_en: Education - Artificial Intelligence - Guidelines, Professional Development, and Collaborative (Artificial Intelligence Ready Schools Act) - SB 720 Fiscal and Policy Note
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Maryland General Assembly, Department of Legislative Services
named_instruments_referenced: National Artificial Intelligence Initiative Act of 2020
annotation.summary_en: Maryland Department of Legislative Services enrolled fiscal and policy note on SB 720, the AI Ready Schools Act. It requires MSDE AI guidance, local school AI policies and coordinators, an evaluation rubric, AI literacy standards, educator training, and a state AI education collaborative, with fiscal impacts estimated.
key_provisions_or_claims: MSDE must issue AI guidance for schools, educators, parents and students via online platform
Local school systems must adopt AI policy within 120 days and designate an AI coordinator
MSDE to publish rubric for evaluating AI tools; local systems must procure consistent with DoIT standards
AI literacy to be added to K-12 computer science and workforce standards by June 1, 2027
Creates Maryland AI Education Collaborative through May 2028; state cost $610,100 in FY2027
